parameters.content:
## DryRun turn
How the room reacts to what the presenter just said (POST /webhook/dryrun/turn, docs/CONTRACT.md): transcribes it, decides whether anyone speaks, who, what and why (or why nobody does), holds that to the rules (every question a thread: one follow-up, then answered, parked or dodged), and voices it. The laptop sends the context, so this keeps no state. No Code nodes on this path: their runner takes about 1.7 s to start, expressions don't.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const b = $json.body || $('What the presenter said (headset)').first().json.body; const ctx = b.context || {}; const bundle = ctx.bundle || {}; const people = bundle.personas || []; const who = people.find(p => p.id === b.asked_by); const open = b.mode === 'answer' ? (ctx.threads || ctx.pending || []).filter(t => t.persona_id === b.asked_by && t.status !== 'answered' && t.status !== 'parked' && t.status !== 'dodged').pop() : null; return [open ? open.text : '', who ? who.display_name : '', (bundle.prospect || {}).company].concat((bundle.slides || []).map(s => s.title), people.map(p => p.display_name)).filter(Boolean).join(', ').slice(0, 600); })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.text, language_code: 'en-IN', model: 'bulbul:v3', speaker: $json.speaker, speech_sample_rate: 22050, output_audio_codec: 'mp3' }) }}

={{ (() => { const j = $('What the room knows').first().json.room; return JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: j.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"note": {"type": "string"}, "reactions": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"persona_id": {"type": "string"}, "kind": {"type": "string", "enum": ["welcome", "question", "follow_up", "acknowledge", "park", "move_on", "hand_back", "open_floor", "closing"]}, "text": {"type": "string"}, "line_id": {"type": "string", "description": "A line voiced ahead of time, or empty"}, "raise_hand": {"type": "boolean"}, "reason": {"type": "string"}, "thread_id": {"type": "string", "description": "The thread this belongs to, or empty for a new question"} }, "required": ["persona_id", "kind", "text", "line_id", "raise_hand", "reason", "thread_id"]} }, "answer_verdict": {"type": "string", "enum": ["resolved", "partial", "dodged", "none"]}, "presenter_unsure": {"type": "boolean"}, "end_session": {"type": "boolean"} }, "required": ["note", "reactions", "answer_verdict", "presenter_unsure", "end_session"]} } }); })() }}
